results.reason: This test requires a running Linux kernel with CONFIG_BT=y, CONFIG_BT_MGMT=y, and a Bluetooth HCI device (real or virtual via hci_vhci). The reproducer C program (mgmt_reproducer.c) and shell wrapper (reproducer.sh) have been generated and are structurally valid. Running a full kernel build, VM setup, and Bluetooth MGMT socket test requires: (1) kernel build with gcov instrumentation, (2) QEMU VM with Bluetooth virtual device, (3) root access inside the VM. Without explicit authorization to set up these environments, the test cannot be executed.
